description: The file defines a class `SimpleGrain` which implements the `ISimpleGrain` interface for the Orleans framework. It manages two integer properties `A` and `B`, provides methods to set, increment, and retrieve their product, and includes logging on activation and deactivation events.

classes.name: SimpleGrain
classes.description: A grain class that manages two integers and performs multiplication, with lifecycle logging.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles activation of the grain, logs activation.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets the value of property A.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets the value of property B.

methods.name: IncrementA
methods.description: Increments the value of A by 1.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Returns the product of A and B from stored values.

methods.name: GetAxB (overload)
methods.description: Returns the product of input parameters a and b.

methods.name: GetA
methods.description: Returns the current value of A.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles deactivation of the grain, logs deactivation.
